svg.text: DESIGN STUDY / ILLUSTRATIVE DATA / NOT A LIVE ANALYSIS
Seven views of a changing Earth.
WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE TO MEASURE?
Live analysis works outside this map.
The map layer covers Europe first.
Colour shows direction and rate; hatching shows statistical support.
Map and time-series source, product and period are always named.
Illustrative data · direction names describe design studies, not the final product name.
